results.title: The Marshmallow Ghosts presents Corpse Reviver No. 3: Possessions
results.original_title: The Marshmallow Ghosts presents Corpse Reviver No. 3: Possessions
results.overview: When Nathan receives a call from an estate-sale dealer who has discovered a box of mysterious tapes bearing ominous handwritten labels, he agrees to come pick them up.  What begins as a simple errand becomes a journey through the forgotten corners of the region. Over the course of a single day, Nathan drives from one location to another, listening to the tapes as an unseen narrator recounts the strange histories and folk stories connected to each place. As each story unfolds, the soundtrack changes with it, turning the landscape itself into a series of haunted tableaux scored by The Marshmallow Ghosts.

results.title: Bad Dad
results.overview: With his divorce barely finalized, Warren retreats from the city he always resented to a quiet lake house, hoping to find some peace with his young son, KJ. But when a stranger named David turns up at the door asking for help, the night takes a turn Warren never could have anticipated. What begins as small talk over pizza unfolds into a taut psychological standoff, exposing secrets, shifting power, and a chilling connection that leaves Warren gasping for air.

results.title: The Scarecrows' Wedding
results.overview: Devoted scarecrows Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, smooth-talking Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own. Chaos follows, and soon Betty's in danger and everything's at risk. Can Harry get back in time and save the day?
